name: Anime Kawaii Dress Up 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Anime Kawaii Dress Up is a beauty game that offers the chance to style 6 cute dolls with a blend of Japanese fashion, mixing styles like cute, daily European, fairy tales, and more. You can create a variety of outfits using categories such as skirts, dresses, hairstyles, tops, accessories, and jewelry.
